sanskrit: lokeśaḥ karaṇāni yasya mahimā taṃ netranāthaṃ stumaḥ netraṃ pañcakasaptakātma śivayornauṃmyekavīraṃ mṛḍam bodhollāso jayati sa guruḥ ko'pyapūrvo rahasyaḥ śaivaṃ netramanugrahāya jagato'mutraiduddyotate rasayata sarasāḥ parimalamasārasaṃsāravāsanāśāntyai pṛṣṭavatī prārthaye, etanniḥśeṣaṃ me prapannāyā vaktumarhasi vaktraṃ yasya pāṭhe spaṣṭo'rthaḥ nirṇītatattvaṃ tat śṛṇomi adhijigamiṣāmi jātaḥ, ityetadviruddhamābhāsamānaṃ samarthayasva parameśvareti ṣoḍhā saṃbandhaḥ prasiddha eva tādṛg anuttamamucyate vā bhāviduḥkhāsparśāt sarvaduḥkhavimokṣadam ityādi anena caikaviṃśādhikārabhāvisṛṣṭyādyupakṣiptam jīvānāṃ parametatsantāraṇam viśeṣānukteḥ sarvaṃ mahāvīryarūpatvāt bhedānantyena nānāvaicitryeṇa prasṛtam mahyamiti madartham, spaṣṭaṃ śiṣṭam yāvat te prathamo'dhikāraḥ suṣṭhu pīḍitāḥ sarve mucyante nivṛttasarvopadravā apavṛjyante bhagavato'sādhyamiti smitaṃ vidhāya

viśeṣataḥ pratijānīte, atyantopādeyatvādasyārthasya etadadhikārapratijñā darśayiṣyāmaḥ mātā mātṛkā aśeṣamantrādijananī proddharediti pūjānantaramityarthaḥ padārthajātasyaikapraṇavātmatā darśitā iti śrīpūrve'bhidhānādardhacatasraḥ koṭayo'dhikṛtāḥ tadaṅkuśordhvavinyastaṃ tiryaggāntordhvayojitam bindurardhacandrādiprameyāsūtraṇaparaḥ saṅgatirdarśitā prabhañjanāntaśirasaṃ hṛdayaṃ sarvasiddhidam siddhīrdadāti pāramparyeṇa śivaśaktyetyanenordhvagasarvamāntraprameyamuktam, varma kavacam sarvapāpadāhī | cakāraḥ paraviśrāntipradatvaṃ samuccinoti anenādhikārāntarasaṅgatiḥ sūciteti śivam mantroddhāro dvitīyo'dhikāraḥ mṛdamuddhṛtya snānamārabheteti saṅgatiḥ .........ṣaptabhiḥ śuddhyate punaḥ tadadṛṣṭau prāṇārkaspṛṣṭām, nijavivakṣitaṃ caitadanulepanam savyāpasavyagatān tarpaṇaṃ kuryāt svātmalīnaṃ kṛtvā, yāgagṛhaṃ bhāvividhinā viśet vaicitryamutpādayituṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ kuryāt dagdhaṃ bhāvayet

tatra dehe cintite jñeyaśūnyatvād vyāpi cinmātraṃ smaret sanmanaḥ samarasīgataṃ cinmātrarūpaṃ jātam evaradābhayāmṛtakalaśapūrṇendukaratā upacaryate'nenetyupacāraḥ kusumanaivedyādi utpannaṃ samullasitamamṛtaṃ paraṃ śāktaṃ vīryam kṛpālutvāt mānasaistattatsiddhyucitaiḥ iti pratyabhijñoktanītyā tritvena vibhaktamityarthaḥ sudhūpitaṃ kṛtvā ityarthaḥ | anyat spaṣṭam miśraiḥ sitalohitācchādirūpaiḥ yasyāstām castvarthe | ayute daśasāhasre hastamānānusārocitamekhalādimānam dehoccāṭanādikarmabhedena | śiṣṭamiti trikoṇaṣaṭkoṇādirūpam gomayotpuṃsanam kuryāt tritattva iti praṇava ihatyo mūlamantro vā prokṣaṇatāḍanakuṇḍalyātmakakuṇḍakalpanāni kuryāt śivāgnistadāpādanam | tridhā bhramaṇaṃ ca praṇavenaiva yadatra tattvaṃ tat śrīsvacchandoddyote darśitam pūjātmasaṃskāramukhāvirbhāvisaṃskārān kuryāt samānatantrāpekṣatvāt | evamuttaratrāpi sarvasaṃskārān vahnau karomi svāhā" ityatrohaḥ vidhānamanantaraṃ bhaviṣyati | kṣīravṛkṣaḥ śvetārkādiḥ śrīparṇībilvādyutthau

ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulamānateti viśeṣaḥ pīṭhamānaṃ bhavati dvyaṅgulīkāryamityarthaḥ | samutsedha aunnatyam vartulaṃ bhavati patrāvalyādi | suracitamiti tu spaṣṭam madhyamatribhāgamānaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ mukhāgramaṣṭāṅgulamānāttribhāgaṃ bhavati madhyenājyadhārāpātāya saṃskārau noktau amṛtamudrātra pradarśyā hutena sādhakasya sarvān kāmānavāpnoti satyameva na cānyathā spaṣṭam īhitaṃ kāmamuddiśya īhitaṃ homamācaret payasā kevalenaiva homānmṛtyuṃ jayed dhruvam netrodyote yajanādistṛtīyo'dhikāraḥ parāparavibhūtirmokṣabhogau saṃpādyau sarvatrāviśiṣṭau dīkṣākramasyāvirodhāt evaṃ hyanālasyanaiḥspṛhyābhyāṃ daiśikānāmuttamatā kuryāt putrakāṇāṃ paratattva eva, samayināmīśvaratattva iti vibhāgāḥ dīkṣādhikāraścaturthaḥ sāracintanena saha śirasi kalaśāmbhaḥkṣepātmakam khyānaṃ tanmayatayā prathā yeṣām atrāpi śrīsvacchandādyuktā sarvā prakriyānusaraṇīyā

spaṣṭamanyat sāmānyakarmāṇi vaśyākarṣaṇādīni netrodyote'bhiṣekavidhirnāma pañcamo'dhikāraḥ daurgatyādiharam yattat saṃpravakṣyāmi pūrvoktāḥ sarvātmakaṃ paramādvayam | etaccāṣṭamādhikāre nirṇeṣyate yāgādi niścayasyaiva siddhinimittatvāt spaṣṭam yasya nāmnā tasyetyarthāt samidhaḥ mantrarājaprasādāt svacchandoktanītyā sarvatrātra vaṣaṭjātiḥ prayojyā mūlamantreṇetyarthāt japo'tra svakalpoktavidhinā prayuktamityarthaḥ mṛtyumuttarati | kṛtveti antarbhāvitaṇijartho'pi jīvaddehasyāyaṃ rodhanaprayogaḥ saptāhaṃ madhumadhye nihitaṃ ca mṛtyujit sādhyaśarīraṃ svasthatāmeti prakṛṣṭā bhuktimuktilakṣaṇā siddhirarthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya etatkalaśābhiṣekāt sarvo'bhīṣṭaphalamāpnotītyarthaḥ śāstrāntaravyavahāreṇa evaṃ sthūlaṃ vidhānaṃ tu sūkṣmaṃ caivādhunā śṛṇu

iti śivam netrodyote sādhanavidhiḥ ṣaṣṭho'dhikāraḥ sūkṣmadhyānāmṛtonmiṣacchāktamūrtirbhavati kāryaḥ unmanāparatattvātmani dhāmni sadāśivaṃ tathā śaktiṃ śivasthānaṃ prabhedayet vijñānenordhvaṃ dvādaśāntaṃ yāvadvisaret prasaret tadbhavanti tanmayā jāyanta ityarthaḥ śatulyo bhavati na kasyacinmayākhyātaṃ tvadṛte bhaktavatsale tavaiva parānugrahaikavratāyā evaṃ prakaṭīkṛtam netrodyote sūkṣmadhyānanirūpaṇaṃ nāma saptamo'dhikāraḥ māyāntasadāśivāntaśivāntabhavābhavātibhavarūpe spaṣṭam bhavatītyarthaḥ bhavapāśānāṃ nikṛntakaḥ dhyānaṃ viduravicchinnena pāramparyeṇa jānanti | ca evārthe paraḥ samādhiḥ smṛtaḥ pāramparyataḥ prasiddhaḥ nityoditatvenāvyutthānaṃ samādhānam tatsamādhānaṃ vidustattvajñāḥ dṛṣṭvā sākṣātkṛtya, na purjanmaiti caitanyamātmano rūpaṃ sarvaśāstreṣu kathyate "caitanyamātmā" iti prārambha evoktam dhyeyamityanugrāhakatvena buddhyopasthāpitam ityānandapadasaṃlīnasamarasajñānamayaḥ

sāṃsārikī sthitimujjhati tasyā yadbalaṃ vimarśadāḍharyaṃ tena bhāvayet yogī atratya ityarthaḥ coktyānāśvastānāmapyāśvāsaṃ rohayati iti sarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ priye śivam netrodyote aṣṭamo'dhikāraḥ iti | cintāratnādiva phalodayo yataḥ siddhāntavāmadakṣiṇādiśāstroktaṃ phalaṃ pradadāti tadicchāvagrāhitatatphalābhiniveśatayā bhāvanurūpeṇāśayānuguṇena | bhāvena bhāvanāprakāreṇa sadāśivatanurbhavati sādāśivīmiva mūrtimanugrahāyāśrayati spheṭakamudyamanakam vidhiḥ siddhāntoktaḥ prakāraḥ prapūjayet netrodyote navamo'dhikāraḥ siddhānteṣvapi niṣkalasvatantrapārameśavyāpterbhāvāt athavā himakundendumuktāphalasamadyutim ityādi | yathānurūpaṃ dhyānānusāri sūryakoṭisamaprakhyāṃ jvalitāgnisamaprabhām digambarāmiti gajacarmottarīyāmityetadapekṣo'yamarthādvikalpaḥ parivāro mūlamantreṇa pūjya iti bhāvirakṣāvidherjñātam rocanākuṅkumenaiva kṣīreṇa sitayā tathā | naivedyairyo balistena sahitairāsavairiti saṃbandhaḥ

netrodyote daśamo'dhikāraḥ uttamatvamasya parādvayasāraitanmantravyāptiyuktyaiva mūlenaiva kandaṃ kapālam karadvayenopalakṣitā iti tatraivābhidhānādevaṃrūpaḥ cintyaḥ vaśyādivaicitryeṇa mahābalaṃ śāntyādāvapratihatam mantracakratṛptyarthamityarthāt | pūrvavaditi vartula ityarthaḥ atra jagati | jayati īhitāptyā sarvotkarṣeṇa vartata iti śivam netrodyote ekādaśo'dhikāraḥ kulāmnāyanidarśanam | yāgaṃ homaṃ japaṃ kāryaṃ yena sarvamavāpnuyāt kulāmnāyadarśanaśabdārthaḥ vāmo varadaḥ mahāsaṃbhāreṇetyarthaḥ ityarthaḥ sṛṣṭyunmukhaṃ saṃpādayanti ityādi śrīsvacchandoktamanusartavyamiti śivam netrodyote dvādaśo'dhikāraḥ ihatyavyāptyā pūrṇabhogāpavargadam ihatyamantravimṛśyamānamityarthāt aṅgānāṃ vinyāsaḥ prāgvat karpūrī candanī caiva kastūrī kuṅkumī tathā anekavaktrasaṃghātairanekāstrabhujaistathā avyakta ityetadākhyaḥ, sa ca niṣkalaḥ suśāntasvarūpaḥ

mṛtyujiddhāmetyarthāt sūryaṃ dhyāyet athavāṣṭabhujaṃ devi lokapālāyudhānvitam candrādiṣaṭkaṃ keturāhū ceti grahāḥ | dvitīyake ityāvaraṇe saṃdaṃśamiti bibhratam vṛṣārūḍhaṃ caturbhujamiti sadāśivarūpādviśeṣaḥ prāgvat netrodyote trayodaśo'dhikāraḥ niścitaṃ sat paraṃ rahasyam iti sthityānaupamyādirūpam | śiṣṭaṃ prāgeva vyākṛtaprāyam śobhanā siddhirmuktiparyavasānā bhuktiḥ netrodyote caturdaśo'dhikāraḥ upalakṣaṇaṃ caitatpuṣpādeḥ evaṃ varṇabhedāśrayaḥ karmabhedaḥ purākalpe'bhūt sito lohitaśceti dvirūpo'dya tu uttamatvānna pracaratītyarthaḥ kurvantītyarthaḥ dakṣiṇayā toṣitaḥ | phalaṃ muktisiddhī, evamuttaratra namaskāraśca devānāṃ vauṣaṭ śāntau praśasyate svadheti svadhāśabdaḥ | spaṣṭamanyat netrodyote pañcadaśo'dhikāraḥ kūṭānām anye sāmānyato devi na siddhyanti kadācana yāvat sādhakasyecchayā ceṣṭaḥ siddhido bhavati dhruvam dīkṣākāle tu kartavyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ yatra tatra hi gṛhe vā parvatāgrādau vā

hiṃsāparā dṛśyante, tataḥ suguptataiva yuktā spaṣṭamanyat tatheti suguptyā niḥsaṃśayatayā ca ityarthaḥ nityādiṣu sāmānyena viśeṣeṇa kaulikenātha suvrate siddhidaḥ trāṇakṛt śivarūpaḥ vāśabda uttarapakṣadāḍhrye tenaiveti paramaśivatayā'parijñātena dehādimayatvādbhārabhūtaḥ nānāsaṃniveśamātrakalpakaḥ, na tu vyāptijñaḥ tatra tatra śāstre bhinnābhāsatvamiva śivaśaktyoḥ, tatra viśāradastatsamāveśamayaḥ parameśamukhaṃ parā śaktiḥ śāntikādīni karmāṇi viṣabhūtagrahādiṣu sadyaḥ pratyayetyarthaḥ karmaṇā bhogasaktasya abhilāṣānvitasya ca śaktimatsvarūpāyattatvāt śakteḥ pūrvaślokārthaḥ bhagavatpūjārthamārabheta āpado naśyanti tasya śāntirbhavet kṣipraṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ācāryakṛtena sādhyasya

sādhyasya mantreṇa rakṣyasya ātmanaḥ parasya vetyarthaḥ cakratraye dalapuñjatraye | sādhyārṇarodhanaṃ prāgvat jīvaḥ sakāraḥ, tadantaḥkṛtanāmakam saṃbhṛtaiḥ saṃbhāraiḥ praṇavasvanāmanamobhiḥ tattvajñagurupūjā sādhayatyabhīṣṭamiti śivam netrodyote ṣoḍaśo'dhikāraḥ pararāṣṭravibhītānāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ vijayāvaham rakṣā hyeṣā prakartavyā sarvopadravanāśinī spaṣṭam pūjājapahomādibhirārādhayet śāntikarmaṇyavasthito guruḥ sāvadhānaḥ syādityarthaḥ vauṣaḍantamantrarājakṛtāpyāyanam kalaśenetyapapāṭhaḥ vajreṇa caturaśraṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tanmadhye nyasyet pūrvavat padmamālikhya ṣaḍaṅgaṃ pūrvavat priye netrodyote saptadaśo'dhikāraḥ siddhikāraṇāni teṣāṃ sādhanamātmāyattatāpādanaṃ jānāti viniyojanaṃ tena sādhakeśvarāḥ siddhyanti āpnuvanti abhīṣṭam udayāstamayau vyāptiṃ dhyānaṃ mudrāṃ svarūpataḥ evamanyairaśeṣaiśca bhāvabhedaiḥ sureśvari bhāgyāvahamimam tiśabdalopa eśaḥ | endravāruṇe iti pūrvāparāyatānītyarthaḥ susamatvaṃ bhramāṇāṃ svātmani, samāṃśatvaṃ tu parasparam dātavyā, ante bahirbhāge pītalā haritālādiyojitā

sarvataḥ sarvāsu dikṣu | vīthī pūjāpradeśamārgaḥ vyāptiṃ yāgasya prakāśayitum kārayet vibhāga utpadyate bhūtasaṃkhyākāḥ pañcetyarthaḥ pūrvadine'dhivāsaḥ kartavya ityarthaḥ dhvajāni citracihnāni pañcaraṅgāṇīti sūtrāṇi kāryau mṛtyujit pārameśvaraṃ rūpam śaktiṃ tarpayediti saṅgatiḥ śrīsvacchande'sti caivaiśvarīṃ śubhām paṭe tu likhitā devī yasya veśmani pūjyate agre prārambhe devyāḥ prasādato jayamāpnotīti saṃbandhaḥ so'bhīṣṭamāpnotītyarthaḥ vipaścitā vyāptijñena | sarvakāmāṃśceti cakārād muktim ḍāvyo ḍāmarikā devyo bhaginyo dūtayastathā bhāvabhedānusārāsāditasvocitasiddhayaḥ sarvabhuktimuktipradetyarthaḥ śrīmadamṛteśaikaviṣayaḥ prāgavasthāpekṣā uktiḥ śivaikyamiyāt kṛśasthūlam

ativitatakālaṃ bhogalakṣmīmāsādayatīti śivam netrodyote aṣṭādaśo'dhikāraḥ cakārād dṛṣṭipātādeḥ bhūtāśca vividhākārā hyanantāśca mahābalāḥ chāyādidoṣaiḥ paśūpahārayuktyaiva bhagavadarcāniṣṭhāḥ bhavantīti śeṣaḥ anuktairiti brahmahananādibhiḥ, anyairiti mitradrohādibhiḥ tayā anugamaḥ saṃbandhaḥ labdhacchidrā hītyarthāntaranyāsaḥ tatkṣaṇaṃ na vilambeta svalpenaiva kṛtena hi tadeti tata ityarthaḥ | samācarediti pratīkāram pañcagavyena vā tatra mantrayuktena kārayet bhavediti śeṣaḥ ityādinā granthena kṛtsno mātṛsamūhastu tuṣṭo bhavati tatkṣaṇāt sitaraktapītakṛṣṇaiḥ puṣpairnānāvidhaistathā bhūrimadyaistathā māṃsai raktapuṣpavilepanaiḥ tena tena mantreṇātratyenaiva iti kriyākālaguṇottare lakṣitāḥ | rakṣodhipo nirṛtiḥ devatāyoginībhūtādibhyaḥ iti tatraivoktam | pūrvoktavidhiriha mantreṇa arcāhomādi mahānavamyāmeva samāsaḥ, saṅgho mātṛyoginyādigaṇaḥ bhūrihomeneti sahārthe tṛtīyā

arśāṃsi cakṣūrogāśca tathā visarpakādayaḥ ābhyantarā vyādhayaśca śokādyāścittanāśakāḥ tadā tu pūrvavadyāgaḥ kartavyaḥ śāntihetave asyāsti jñatvakartṛtvaśūnyaḥ prāpitasaṃsārabhāvasya bhogādāvityādigrahaṇāt sāṃkhyādidṛṣṭe tāttvike pakṣe'pi triṃśattattvātma māyākāryaṃ māyākhyaṃ malam kośakāraḥ krimiryadvadātmānaṃ veṣṭayed dṛḍham saugatamīmāṃsakasāṃkhyādibhiriṣyate sarveṣāmanugrāhako'sau grāhyagrāhakādikāluṣyollāsikā'parārūpā co hyarthe | dānaṃ śivatvābhivyakteḥ, kṣapaṇaṃ tu pāśānām vyāpakasyāṇoḥ svarūpaprakāśanāt kriyāśaktirūpā maheśvarīti prabhaviṣṇuḥ rakṣā uktā iti lakṣaṇamuktam | durādharṣā balino duḥsahāśca śivaśaktiprabhāvastadājñāvaśavartitā rakṣā kriyate, sā sukṛtā syāt samyak pravakṣyāmi vyākhyāsyāmi yadā strī mudritā bhūtaistadā garbho na saṃbhavet asminniti retoraktātmani | bījasaṃbhavo garbhādhānam kāryamiti, sūtikāgṛhamityarthāt tamapi bhūtā hiṃsanti, tasmād rakṣet kṣīrasparśādipoṣaṇaiḥ śriyo bhogamokṣavitaraṇaruco jīvanaṃ vācyarūpaṃ caitanyam

na bhavanti ceti bāhulyena na bhavantītyarthaḥ | araha iti eśaḥ pāṭha iti śivam netrodyote ekonaviṃśo'dhikāraḥ jijñāsāṃ sphuṭayati ca evārthe prāptanirmalaśivaikarūpā bhavanti jñānakriyāśaktyātmatāṃ ca paritaḥ samantādupāsate tanmayatvena sphuranti prāpayet |" ityādi cchindyādityarthaḥ saṃgṛhītam, tat sarvaṃ kṣipramātmaniṣṭhaṃ kuryāt mṛtoddhārādidīkṣyatvamucyate mantrakramāditīhatyamāntraparāmarśayuktyā rakṣet sūkṣmayogamudritaṃ kadācin mocayituṃ kṣamaḥ dāruṇād doṣād mocako bhavatyeva ityādi kāruṇyādevānyasya kuryāt yasmin deśe'thavā rāṣṭre nivasenmantrayogavit yadīccheduttamāṃ siddhiṃ mokṣaṃ vā śāśvataṃ dhruvam anugrahārthaṃ martyānāṃ bhūpatīnāṃ kuṭumbinām yoginībhūtādyā nityaśuddhā rāgadveṣādihīnāḥ ājñaptā iti pūrvoktadurācāracchidraṇāya niyuktāḥ anenetyatacchāstroddiṣṭena daityonmūlanātmanā tattvavidaṃ iti śeṣa iti śivam netrodyote viṃśo'dhikāraḥ

saṃpracoditā ityuktam, kena prakāreṇa kartrā cetyarthaḥ nistimitaṃ sāṃkhyapuruṣakalpamadvayaṃ brahma icchanti (śrīkiraṇā. ) iti siddhīrvitarantītyarthaḥ āṇavatvādātmavanmalinā eva parapramātṛprameyātmatāṃ vinā kiṃcidapyupadyate yathāpraśnitaṃ sarvaṃ brūhi śaktimadavyatirekāt śāmbhavā apītyarthaḥ paśyantyādipadeṣviva vācyavācakakramaṃ jīvaḥ paraṃ śuddho'dhvā, aparaṃ tvaśuddhaḥ sarvatrānugrahādāvapratihataṃ śaktatvaṃ yeṣām mahāsāmarasyaviśrāntyātmā āndo yasya, sa nirānandaḥ jyeṣṭhādiśaktibhedenocyate saṅkocābhāsavato'pi citprakāśātmatayaiva grāhakatvāduttamatvam sthitisaṃhṛtyupalakṣaṇaparam parameśa ityarthaḥ | sūkṣmatvādityavedyatvāt bhāsayati, na tvanādisiddhaṃ tadityāśayaḥ iti śivasvātantryamaparāmṛśyāṇvapekṣatvameva mantrāṇāmāhuḥ bhūruktā, sṛjatītyanena tu śaktibhūmiḥ ityāha dhvanirūpo yadā sphoṭastvadṛṣṭācchivavigrahāt | atra ca nādānto'pyanupraviṣṭaḥ makārādakārāntamātmatattvātmatvena mantrasṛṣṭiruktā mātṛkājñānaśālinaḥ nigrahānugrahakṛtaḥ śivadāśivahārakāśceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ netrodyote ekaviṃśo'dhikāraḥ

nirṇītaṃ caitat prāgeva praṇavoccāraṇānte viśramitavyamityarthaḥ kṛtvā ālayaṃ ca tacchaktibṛṃhitatvādeva śāktāstanmayā evetyarthaḥ māntraṃ prameyam kāryeṇānābilīkṛtatvād vimalāḥ, anugrahapravaṇatvāt śubhāḥ nirodhikā kalā hyetā sarvadevanirodhikāḥ eṣātmakatvāt kuto'tyantanairmalyam śaktyādisamanāntānāmiti svaprakāśasvarūpaśca na vindati yadā mantrī sṛṣṭisaṃhāravartmanī tata ājñāṃ pālayet gamyate nīyate, gamirṇijanto'tra uddyotātma samagraśakti śivayornetraṃ paraṃ tannumaḥ no raktaṃ na ca naitadātma tadidaṃ netraṃ jayatyaiśvaram netrodyote dvāviṃśo'dhikāraḥ bhāsvaddyota sa doṣa eṣa viṣamasteṣāṃ dṛśastādṛśaḥ śrīrāmādigurugrāmastathāntevāsino'pare akārṣurme tataḥ kiṃcididamudyotitaṃ mayā parādvaitāmṛtasphīto netrodyoto'yamutthitaḥ parimalasarasānāṃ vyākarocchāstrametat asmābhirvimale hṛdambaratale niryantraṇaṃ sphī(sthī)yate jyotirnetraṃ jayati paramānandapūrṇaṃ tṛtīyam
